name: Casino Management
author: Webnow

sections.description:
Casino Management is a feature-rich WordPress plugin designed to help manage casino-related content with ease.
With this plugin, you can:

  • Create and manage betting listings with full details.
  • Add betting descriptions, ratings, and other fields.
  • Display casino-related promotions, bonuses, and events.
  • Generate SEO-friendly pages for casino listings.

This plugin is ideal for casino affiliates, gambling websites, and online gaming directories.

Usage

Adding a Betting Listing

  1. Go to Casino Management > Add New Betting List.
  2. Enter Betting Details and other details like such as betting list title name and description.
  3. Click Publish to make the betting list.

Adding a Casino Management

  1. Go to Casino Management > Add New Casino Management
  2. Enter Casino Management Details such as casino management title, casino description and other details.
  3. Click Publish to make the Casino.

Displaying Casino Listings on a Page

Use the following shortcode to display a list of casinos:

[casino_management id="123"]
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and select the downloaded zip file.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.
  5. Navigate to Casino Management in the WordPress admin dashboard to start configuring the plugin.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with the latest WordPress version?

Yes, the plugin has been tested and is compatible with WordPress 6.8.

Can I customize the styling?

The plugin does not include built-in support for CSS customization, but you can override the styles using custom CSS in your theme.

How do I add custom fields to casino listings?

You can use a custom fields plugin or modify the plugin’s templates using hooks and filters.

Do I need any additional plugins for this to work?

Yes, the plugin requires Advanced Custom Fields Pro to function properly.

Does this plugin work with any WordPress theme?

Yes, Casino Management is designed to work with most WordPress themes.

Can this plugin’s files be overridden in a WordPress theme?

Yes, you can create a casino-management folder in your theme and copy the plugin’s template files into it. Any modifications you make there will be reflected on the frontend.
